Meet your artist

Different styles.
The same dedication.

Three artists, three studios. Find the style that fits your idea and the artist who lives for it.

01 · Palisades Mall

Mav

Born in the Philippines and tattooing for more than 15 years, Mav leads the Palisades Mall studio. Black and grey and neotraditional are his specialties, with range well beyond them.

Black & grey Neotraditional Consult with Mav View portfolio ↗ 02 · Poughkeepsie Galleria

Nico

aka Nano

Raised in The Bronx and Washington Heights, Nico is a self-taught artist with more than five years of tattooing behind him, and he pierces too. He leads the Poughkeepsie Galleria studio.

Neo traditional Script Anime Japanese Trash polka Fine line Consult with Nico View portfolio ↗ 03 · Galleria at Crystal Run

Anthony

aka Ant

Anthony was drawing portraits of fellow subway riders in The Bronx at 10 years old. More than 11 years into tattooing, he leads the Galleria at Crystal Run studio.

Contemporary blackwork Surrealism Consult with Anthony View portfolio ↗

Body piercings

Where it
all started.

Piercing is where Pierce It Or Ink It began: one mall kiosk in 2019. Ears, noses, lips, navels and more. See the work, then tell us what you have in mind.

Questions about placement, jewelry or which studio to visit? Ask before you come in.

Ask About a Piercing

Locations

Find yours.

Each studio has its own lead artist. Pick the one closest to you, or the artist whose work speaks to you.

15+ Years tattooing Mav 11+ Years tattooing Anthony 5+ Years tattooing Nico 2019 Piercing since Where it began

Good to know

How do I book?

+

Message us on Instagram at @pierceitorinkit. That's where we book appointments and answer questions.

Which artist works at which studio?

+

Mav leads Palisades Mall, Nico leads Poughkeepsie Galleria and Anthony leads Galleria at Crystal Run.

Do you do body piercings?

+

Yes. Piercing is where Pierce It Or Ink It started. Ask us about the piercing you want and which studio to visit.

Where can I see more work?

+

Each artist has a full portfolio linked above, and new work is posted on our Instagram.

Your next piece

Got an idea?
Let's make it yours.

Tell us what you're thinking: a tattoo, a piercing, or just the start of an idea. Choose your studio and name an artist if you already have one in mind.

Prefer to message us?
